hints.title: Two Alternating Targets
hints.text: An alternating binary string must either start with 0 (010101...) or start with 1 (101010...).

hints.title: Count Mismatches for One Pattern
hints.text: Count how many characters in s differ from expected characters for the pattern starting with 0.

hints.title: Derive Complement Pattern
hints.text: Cost for pattern starting with 1 is simply n minus cost for pattern starting with 0. Return min of both.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of binary string
complexity.whyNaiveFails: No naive bottleneck exists; linear scan is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant space single pass tracks mismatch count.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes complementary nature of the two valid alternating targets.
